subject: Contrack status - plural mentions are the long pole
body:
Status through May 25.

Good: the incremental repository update holds. 60-turn session, p95 update latency 31ms, memory flat at ~4MB per session because we never re-encode the full history. Entity recognition and attribute classification are both within a point of the published numbers.

Bad: resolving plural mentions. Anything of the form "both of them" or "the two engineers" where the antecedents were introduced 8+ turns apart drops to 0.58 F1 against 0.79 for singular coreference. The synthetic generator makes plenty of plural cases but they are too clean - the ambiguity distribution doesn't look like real dialogue, so we're overfitting to easy ones.

Trade-off for you Anders: I can either spend two weeks widening the generator's ambiguity model, or we ship the Jun 12 integration spike with plural mentions behind a flag and fix it in Q3. I lean flag-it, but it's your call on what the demo needs to show.

Fumiko
